# Cursor

Cursor is an AI-powered code editor built on VSCode. The API provides access to Cloud Agents, Admin, Analytics, and AI Code Tracking features.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/cursor/.

## Actions

- **List Agents** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of all Cursor Cloud agents.
- **List GitHub Repositories** (read-only): List GitHub repositories accessible to the authenticated user.
- **Get Agent Conversation** (read-only): Retrieve the conversation history for a specific cloud agent.
- **Get API Key Info** (read-only): Retrieve API key information including the key name, creation date, and owner email.
- **List Available Models** (read-only): Retrieve the list of available AI models in Cursor.
